Definition: Jehu, the name of five Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jehu is the name of five Israelites, and the king who destroyed the house of Ahab is the best known. In 1 Kings 16:1, the word of the LORD came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha. The fuller story is told on the Jehu, King of Israel profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Jehu belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
